name: ifc-utils
description: IFC and BIM software utilities for DTaaS. This file exists to make the packages under packages/ one npm workspace, so one of them can depend on another by version while both are still being written.

scripts._comment_build: In dependency order, which npm does not work out for `run --workspaces`: it takes the workspaces alphabetically, so the viewer built before the converter it takes its types from. That order worked on a machine where dist already existed and failed on every clean checkout.
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/bim-ifc-converter && npm run build --workspace packages/bim-glb-viewer
